channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Quinn Cook | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Quinn Cook from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Quinn Cook, Kevin Durant
item.description:
Connor Letourneau:Steve Kerr on Kevin Durant:

“I did speak with Kevin. Obviously, a very difficult time for Kevin and Kevin's family. Quinn Cook was very close with the victim as well. Very somber mood at shoot-around today. ... For most of us who play this game, this is kind of our refuge.”

Steve Kerr on Quinn Cook, Kevin Durant, Mar 21, 2019. Source: Twitter @Con_Chron.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Quinn Cook
item.description:
Kerr on why Quinn Cook was on the floor late:

“He’s a great shooter. ... There’s no regrets. You only have regrets if you don’t take the shot.”

Steve Kerr on Quinn Cook, May 25, 2018. Source: Twitter @Con_Chron.

item.title: Manu Ginobili on Quinn Cook
item.description:
Connor Letourneau:Ginobili:

“Yeah, we were expecting Cook to start. But it's not like it changed that much. The bottom line is that they played much better than us.”

Manu Ginobili on Quinn Cook, Apr 14, 2018. Source: Twitter @Con_Chron.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Quinn Cook
item.description:
Steve Kerr on Quinn Cook, the two-way rule:

“This year was just so crazy with the injuries that, had we not had the two-way, I really honestly don't know what we would've done.”

Steve Kerr on Quinn Cook, Apr 8, 2018. Source: Twitter @Con_Chron.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Quinn Cook
item.description:
Connor Letourneau:Steve Kerr on Quinn Cook:

“He's going to be in this league for a long time, hopefully with us.”

Steve Kerr on Quinn Cook, Mar 25, 2018. Source: Twitter @Con_Chron.

item.title: Draymond Green on Quinn Cook
item.description:
Draymond Green on Quinn Cook:

“I sit here and I watch teams play and wonder 'How is Quinn Cook a two-way player?' You got guys in the league that can't dribble with their left hand.”

Draymond Green on Quinn Cook, Mar 18, 2018. Source: Twitter @anthonyVslater.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Manny Harris, Quinn Cook, Jarrod Uthoff
item.description:
Rick Carlisle:

“Uthoff and Harris are both very good D-League prospects, both are having terrific years. We wanted to look at them. We’ve been talking about them for a while. Cook played pretty significant minutes and was solid, so we appreciate that. We’ve just got to keep moving forward here.”

Rick Carlisle on Manny Harris, Quinn Cook, Jarrod Uthoff, Mar 9, 2017. Source: Fort Worth Star-Telegram.
